• Update on Cell Phone Ban  -  
• METRO Bus Pass Program at Westbrook High School –  
Superintendent Dr. Peter Lancia asked Westbrook High School Principal Jeffrey Guerette to report on the 
cell phone ban at Westbrook High School and the new Metro Bus Pass Program. 
 
Principal Jeffrey Guerette hoped that people would recognize the upgrades and improvements to the high 
school campus which includes a new scoreboard on Olmsted Field donated  by Art Girard, brand new 
windows on the first floor, new trees in the bus loop.  Solar panels that are being dubbed Ragan ’s Rays to 
honor former science teacher Ragan Hedstrom who was one of the leading voices to bring solar to 
Westbrook High School. 
 
Westbrook High School Principal Jeffrey Guerette reported on the new bell-to-bell cell phone ban and the 
use of Yondr bags for students to use to store their personal devices.  There will be a  technology forum in 
Room 114 at Westbrook High School on Tuesday at 6 p.m. to explain the new personal el ectronic device 
policy and answer questions from families and students. 
 
Westbrook High School Principal Jeffrey Guerette also announced the start of the student METRO 
program that was funded by City Council to provide rides to students to help to increase attend ance and 
give students access to jobs, medical appointments and to get to know their surrounding communities.
